title.zh: Meta盘前转涨1.12%，英伟达、AMD和博通有意购买至多50亿美元Meta股票
title.en: Meta盘前转涨1.12%，英伟达、AMD和博通有意购买至多50亿美元Meta股票

current_state.zh: Meta launched a roughly $35B dual underwritten equity offering — about $22.5B of Class A common stock via forward sale agreements and about $12.5B of Series A mandatory convertible preferred depositary shares — with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom reportedly interested in purchasing up to $5B of Meta stock each, lifting META 1.12% in premarket trading.
